nodes.name: file-analyzer.md
nodes.summary: You read one batch of source files and write a Lens enrich patch. The structure (functions, classes, imports, calls) is already extracted; you add what a parser can't: what each thing is for.

frontmatter.name: security-triager
frontmatter.description: Verifies Lens static security findings against the actual code (confirm, false positive, or accepted) and adds anything the rules missed. Writes a triage patch.
